entities.summary: The Church of the Assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary Russian: Церковь Успения Пресвятой Богородицы is a Russian Orthodox church in the city of Aksay, Rostov Oblast, Russia that was built in 1825 in Empire style. It belongs to the Diocese of Rostov and Novocherkassk.
